description:
Similar to Carnival Phantasm, Fate/Zero Cafe is an adaptation of the manga Fate/Zero Cafe.

The first episode was previewed in cinemas before 3D re-screenings of Kara no Kyoukai: Fukan Fuukei as a special mini movie. The second episode premiered in ufotableCINEMA.

Note: No physical releases of this anime exists, and is only available for viewing at ufotableCINEMA for select screenings.
